gbm_population_evidence.quote: Dose Escalation Study of Monocyte Antigen Carrier Cells for Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma With Unmethylated MGMT Gene Promoter
Newly diagnosed glioblastoma patient with definitive resection prior to enrollment

candidate_evidence.quote: The investigational vaccine (MT-201-GBM) in this study is made from a type of immune cell called monocytes, which have been engineered to express a cytomegalovirus (CMV) protein.
monocytes isolated from patient's leukapheresis loaded with CMV pp65-LAMP (Lysosomal-associated Membrane Protein) mRNA (Messenger Ribonucleic Acid)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma patient with definitive resection prior to enrollment

role_evidence.quote: monocytes isolated from patient's leukapheresis loaded with CMV pp65-LAMP (Lysosomal-associated Membrane Protein) mRNA (Messenger Ribonucleic Acid)

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous monocyte cell vaccine loaded with CMV pp65-LAMP mRNA (MT-201-GBM)

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive a total of 3 intravenous vaccines every 4 weeks after completing standard radiation therapy (XRT) and temozolomide (TMZ) and a single course of dose-intensified TMZ.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, standard of care for glioblastoma

source_quote.quote: MGMT promoter unmethylated (Determined by Caris Life Science pyrosequencing);

coder_notes: Only investigational product is an autologous monocyte mRNA-loaded vaccine (excluded type). Temozolomide (standard chemoradiation plus one dose-intensified cycle) is given to every patient as background before vaccination and is not a registered intervention; coded soc_backbone (dose-intensified cycle is not the investigational question). pp65 T-cell immune response is a vaccine pharmacodynamic endpoint, not related to a pharmacological candidate. Gadolinium is mentioned only in an allergy exclusion and not listed. CMV pp65 is a viral antigen, not a tumour molecular biomarker requirement.
